text:
**Tree-cover loss was detected, but deforestation is not established.** In 2021, approximately 81.3 hectares—2.23% of the asset—experienced mapped tree-cover loss. The 2020 forest reference agrees with 98% of the affected area.

Of the loss area, 68.1 hectares were mapped as planted forest, 13.2 hectares were outside mapped forest, and none was mapped as native forest. Tree-cover loss can include plantation harvesting or other stand replacement; the evidence does not establish the cause or whether the land use changed.
